report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified and contradicted by current telemetry: traces show successful 200 responses across checkout, orders, payment, inventory, and postgres save_order; metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s and no traffic on v2.0.0. Deployment record only documents baseline v1.0.0. No bounded root cause is established; logs were excluded. Handing off for human review.
missing_evidence: Logs for order service (ev-dc792a13d0a8b6ef-r0-order-logs) were excluded; needed to confirm any checkout error signature.
No telemetry shows checkout errors: traces show all /v1/checkout, /v1/orders, payment, inventory returning 200.
Metrics show 0 requests for order version 2.0.0 and no 502s; need evidence of the alleged faulty deployment and its error impact.
Deployment record only shows baseline-order-v1 (1.0.0); no faulty deployment version is documented.
